name: ai.unlimitless/unl
title: Unl
description:
Every new session starts from zero — the decisions you made yesterday, the reasoning behind them, the approach you already ruled out. Gone, so you type it all again. Unl ends that.

Connect once, and Unl holds what you've settled — your decisions, the why behind them, the threads you want to come back to — and serves them back at the exact turn they bear on, unprompted. Your AI picks up where your thinking left off.

Tuned to Claude, Claude Code, Cursor and ChatGPT, and extending across the AI ecosystem — model and platform agnostic: sign in once, and every surface you attach reads the same workspace. Change the model; keep your world.

Unl never writes anything without your word, and never reaches into your model or your files — a boundary that's enforced, not promised. It holds what you give it, and hands it back when it matters.
